title: Taking reforms to the road: From Ranchi protest to a Statewide yatra

Amit Bhelari examines the fallout of the government’s decision to cancel exams, which has left both aspiring candidates and already-appointed government employees caught in the dispute. It has pushed student leader Devendra Nath Mahto from a prolonged protest in Ranchi to a Statewide yatra demanding transparency, accountability and reforms in the government recruitment system

content: Action taken after Excise Commissioner Seeram Sambasiva Rao launched ‘Operation Bijapur’ to verify the veracity of allegations raised against officials.

title: Nepal Floods: Hunt intensifies for 900 missing at hydel units, one tunnel head located
content: As rescue operations intensify in Nepal, over 900 individuals remain unaccounted for in the aftermath of devastating floods that have led to 810 confirmed deaths in both Nepal and Tibet. Teams are utilizing advanced tools at the Upper Trishuli-3A hydropower project to search for survivors. Notably, several Indian nationals are among the missing, which has led India to provide crucial technical and relief assistance for the ongoing rescue efforts.

title: Deepti Sharma scripts history! Stunning 3/0 makes her world's top T20I wicket-taker
content: Deepti Sharma has made history by becoming the leading wicket-taker in Women's T20I cricket, demonstrating her exceptional skills with a remarkable three wickets for no runs in a thrilling match against Thailand in Dubai. With Shafali Verma’s explosive 64 earlier contributing to a solid foundation, India celebrated a resounding 94-run victory, setting an exciting tone for their Asia Cup campaign.

title: 'CJP netas not saints, nothing wrong in having political ambitions': Wangchuk
content: Climate activist Sonam Wangchuk believes organizers of the Cockroach Janta Party movement have political ambitions. He stated that such aspirations are normal and not objectionable if the platform remains non-party. Wangchuk described the organizers as well-meaning and skilled individuals with no current indications of corruption. He advised them to maintain the CJP as a neutral pressure group for broader support.

title: Michael Dell shares a 'special note' for COO as he completes 39 years
content: Dell COO Jeff Clarke marked thirty-nine years with the technology company.  This milestone coincides with Dell's major 'One Dell Way' transformation initiative.  The company is consolidating multiple applications and systems into a single enterprise platform.  This comprehensive change aims to simplify processes and enhance data flow across departments.  The transformation is designed to prepare Dell for an AI-driven business environment.

title: India, Uzbekistan target long-term uranium pact, set annual trade target of $5 bn
content: In a significant diplomatic move, India and Uzbekistan have enhanced their engagement to a comprehensive strategic partnership. They have ambitious plans for trade, aiming for a target of five billion dollars each year. The nations also formalized an agreement for uranium supply and created a foreign minister-level coordination council while signing eleven memorandums of understanding across diverse fields like mining and education.

title: NEET-PG 2026 conducted smoothly; retest on Sept 5 for Jaipur candidates hit by glitch
content: The NEET-PG 2026 examination faced disruption due to a power failure at two Jaipur centres. A retest is scheduled for September 5 for 2,445 affected candidates. A three-member committee will investigate the internal power supply problem. The nationwide examination was conducted with extensive security measures and real-time monitoring. NBEMS expressed regret for the inconvenience caused to the candidates.

title: After renaming ‘Gulf of Mexico’ to ‘Gulf of America’, Google Maps changes name of ‘Lake Ontario’
content: Google Maps has introduced a noteworthy update, displaying Lake Ontario as Lake America for American users. This decision aligns with a new presidential executive order and modifications to the GNIS. Canadian officials maintain the traditional name, highlighting its rich heritage over centuries. Meanwhile, alternative mapping platforms such as MapQuest and Apple Maps have not yet responded to this change, which is tailored regionally depending on the user's location.

title: File FIR against those who did 'purification': Priyanka to PM Modi
content: Priyanka Gandhi Vadra has urged Prime Minister Narendra Modi to order an FIR.  This appeal follows an alleged "purification" of a rally venue in Haldwani.  Rahul Gandhi previously alleged BJP-RSS elements were responsible for the incident.  The Congress leader stated the act violated the Constitution and SC/ST Act.  She questioned the government's inaction over the alleged crime.

title: Seychelles island restoration grew sooty tern colony from 20,000 to 700,000
content: Once threatened by severe ecological decline, Bird Island has transformed into a remarkable conservation achievement. Over decades of exploitation and farming, the island's environment was heavily damaged. However, when Guy Savy and partners took over in 1967, they began restoration and promoted eco-tourism. This initiative has led to a major recovery in seabird numbers, proving that long-term conservation can revitalize damaged ecosystems.

title: Superconductors finally prove quantum imaging effect predicted two decades ago
content: The University of Illinois Chicago’s Dirk Morr proposed a way to create high-resolution quantum images using superconductors two decades ago. A new experiment by researchers in Germany, supported by Morr’s theoretical model, has now produced quantum imaging similar to what he predicted, providing experimental confirmation of his earlier work.

title: Amid software fears, Anthropic CEO says: ‘We’re not here to destroy anyone’
content: Anthropic's CEO assures investors that AI will not dismantle enterprise software companies.  He views AI expansion as a positive, collaborative evolution for the technology sector.  Wall Street experienced sell-offs after an AI announcement, but software firms have recovered.  Salesforce reported strong growth and client retention, deepening its AI integration.  Concerns persist regarding data security and enterprise autonomy with AI providers.

title: How to avoid rental disputes: Delhi Police plans awareness session for Northeast tenants
content: Delhi Police will host an awareness program next week for Northeast residents.  The event will focus on rental agreements and security deposit issues.  Tenants will learn about their rights and responsibilities regarding rent.  Police will widely circulate advisories with community leaders' help.  This initiative aims to prevent and resolve landlord-tenant disputes effectively.

title: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' beats 'Avatar 2'; third highest-grossing film of all time
content: Coyote vs. Acme debuted strongly in second place at the box office.  The film earned an estimated fifteen point five million dollars over the weekend.  This release follows Warner Bros. decision to cancel the movie for a tax write-off.  Spider-Man: Brand New Day remained the top-grossing film for a fifth week.  The Dog Stars, a new release, opened in fifth place with eight million dollars.

title: Andre Agassi and Steffi Graf’s unique approach to raising their children
content: Andre Agassi made significant sacrifices during his own childhood to ensure his children could experience life freely. Becoming a father to Jaden and Jaz shifted his priorities, emphasizing their happiness over his own athletic legacy. His wife, Steffi Graf, who also faced the rigorous demands of elite sports, shared this perspective, allowing them to focus on nurturing their children's individual passions.

title: Logan Paul vs The Miz net worth 2026: WWE earnings and business ventures
content: Logan Paul and The Miz have taken very different paths to financial success in WWE. Paul has mixed digital media, boxing, wrestling and entrepreneurship, with PRIME Hydration playing a large part in his estimated fortune. The Miz, whose real name is Michael Gregory Mizanin, has amassed a fortune from a long career in WWE, reality television, acting, hosting, and other entertainment endeavors.

title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes donate $1.077M to 20 Kansas City charities
content: The Mahomes Foundation gala achieved a remarkable feat, raising more than one million dollars for charitable organizations in Kansas City. The evening benefited twenty local entities, making a substantial difference in the community. Brittany Mahomes shared her heartfelt appreciation for the positive influence they continue to have, emphasizing the foundation's dedication to children's health and community development through a variety of supportive initiatives.

title: Create social media content against drug menace: PM Modi's message to youth
content: In a call to action, Prime Minister Modi urged young Indians to use social media in innovative ways to fight against drug addiction. He also celebrated the success of the PM SVANidhi scheme in promoting women's economic empowerment, with approximately 35 lakh women benefiting from it to strengthen their businesses.

title: Diabetes impacts men, women differently: Study
content: Type 2 diabetes affects men and women with different health risks. Women face greater mental health challenges after diagnosis, while men experience more heart and kidney issues. Hypertension is a common complication for both sexes following diabetes. People developing mental health conditions after diabetes tend to die earlier. The study suggests sex-specific diabetes care and monitoring are needed.

title: Right to question not defiance, every dissent not a threat: SC judge
content: Supreme Court judge Ujjal Bhuyan stressed that governments must listen to citizens and allow dissent. He stated that questioning is an essential expression of citizenship and liberty in democracies. Universities should foster free thinking and encourage students to ask difficult questions. Intolerance undermines the constitutional framework when disagreement is silenced or punished. A democracy's maturity is shown by its response to unpopular or inconvenient opinions.

title: Nepal floods: Stranger ran past school screaming ‘Run, water’. It saved 370 kids, teachers
content: An unidentified man's warning saved over 370 pupils and teachers from a massive flood. Students and staff scrambled to a forested hill as floodwaters surged rapidly. Communications were disrupted, making it difficult to account for all students after the event. One father tragically perished while attempting to reach the school for his son. The school continues efforts to trace pupils and reunite them with their families.

title: Russia strike on Kyiv ammunition depot kills 38 in year's deadliest attack as Zelenskyy blames officials
content: A devastating drone strike on an ammunition depot near Kyiv resulted in the tragic loss of 38 lives. The following blasts left unexploded shells scattered across civilian areas. In light of this catastrophe, Ukrainian authorities are re-evaluating their ammunition storage methods. Meanwhile, Russia has escalated its aerial assaults on Ukraine, prompting Kyiv to promise a stringent response to every act of aggression.

title: 3 masked men rob Congress leader Alka Lamba's father's Delhi home; CCTV video emerges
content: Early Sunday, a shocking burglary took place at Alka Lamba's father's home in west Delhi, involving three masked thieves. They stole Rs 1.75 lakh in cash and a selection of jewelry, as recorded by nearby CCTV cameras. The incident occurred in the C-Block, Tagore Garden area, with police now analyzing the footage to identify the suspects and recover the stolen items.

title: Army aviation pilots pull off daring high-altitude helicopter rescue at 18,600ft in Ladakh
content: In a remarkable display of bravery, Indian Army Aviation pilots executed a complicated high-casualty evacuation near the Nun Kun massif. With no flat landing area available, they skillfully rescued a casualty from a steep slope, overcoming the challenges posed by high altitude, where helicopter engine efficiency is diminished. To aid the mission, the crew efficiently removed unnecessary equipment from the aircraft, showcasing their exceptional talent and valor.

title: Kabul, Kashmir, Mumbai, Pahalgam: Hafiz Saeed’s deadly four-decade terror trail
content: India has formally charged Hafiz Muhammad Saeed, the founder of Lashkar-e-Taiba, in connection with a new case of terrorism. The Mumbai Police have initiated proceedings for a trial in absentia, highlighting the legacy of LeT across various phases. Originating from the Afghan jihad in the 1980s, the organization has transitioned from focusing on Kashmir insurgency to embracing a wider range of terror operations.

title: KPSC veterinary recruitment scam: CID detains political party functionary in Delhi
content: The CID's inquiry into the veterinary officer recruitment scam is gaining momentum as Detained in Delhi, Basavaraj Kannale, a high-ranking functionary from Bidar district, comes under scrutiny. With established ties to the arrested IAS officer Gyanendra Kumar Gangwar, investigators suspect Kannale's deeper involvement. He is being transported to Bengaluru for further questioning as the CID's investigation uncovers potential links to more accomplices in the case.

title: Best in 112 years! Robinson breaks Bumrah’s mark to claim Test’s best average
content: Ollie Robinson has reached a remarkable milestone in Test cricket, now boasting the best bowling average for bowlers who have played at least twenty Tests. This noteworthy achievement occurred during England's second Test against Pakistan at Lord's, where Robinson's crucial four-wicket spell effectively crushed Pakistan's resistance and solidified England's dominance in the fourth innings.

title: Dipika and Shoaib’s festival vlogs; couple mark Eid and Rakhi; restaurant dream waits
content: Dipika Kakar and Shoaib Ibrahim joyfully celebrated Eid-E-Milad and Raksha Bandhan with their dear family. Despite battling liver cancer and undergoing infusion treatment, Dipika took the time to decorate their home. Shoaib, demonstrating his culinary skills, made kheer and accompanied his father for a health check-up. His sister Saba and niece Reza stopped by to tie the rakhi, while Shoaib shared his aspiration to open a restaurant one day.

title: Asia Cup: Shafali, Deepti help India seal convincing 94-run win over Thailand
content: India kicked off their Women's T20 Asia Cup with an impressive 94-run triumph against Thailand. Shafali Verma ignited the innings with her electrifying batting, laying a robust foundation for the team. The bowlers showcased their prowess, limiting Thailand to a modest score. Highlighting the match, Deepti Sharma reached a remarkable milestone, claiming the title of leading wicket-taker in women's T20I history, ensuring a triumphant start to the tournament for India.

title: 2nd Test: England thrash Pakistan by 194 runs at Lord’s to take 2-0 series lead
content: England celebrated a spectacular 194-run victory over Pakistan at Lord's, clinching a commanding 2-0 lead in the three-match Test series. Despite their efforts, Pakistan's batsmen faltered, unable to surpass the 200-run mark. Ollie Robinson shone brightly, claiming eight wickets in a remarkable bowling display. This series victory represents England's first Test win since December 2024, boosting their confidence moving forward.

title: Mandhana scripts history in Asia Cup, surpasses Suzie Bates for international record
content: In a remarkable feat during the Women’s Asia Cup match, Smriti Mandhana surpassed Suzie Bates to become the second-highest run-scorer in women's international cricket history, amassing an impressive total of 10,756 runs. Her exceptional performance supported India's 159-run total against Thailand, leading to a victorious start for the team in the tournament.

title: Bengaluru techie dies, lover injured after jumping from 7th-floor terrace following dispute
content: A 23-year-old software engineer died and her boyfriend was injured after a fall. The couple allegedly argued before going to the seventh-floor terrace of their accommodation. Police suspect the woman jumped and pulled her boyfriend along with her. The injured man is undergoing treatment and is reportedly out of danger. Further details are expected after the boyfriend gives his statement to authorities.

title: Passengers fume as SpiceJet Dubai flight delayed by nearly 18 hours at Amritsar airport
content: At Sri Guru Ramdas Ji International Airport, chaos erupted as a SpiceJet flight to Dubai experienced an extraordinary delay of nearly eighteen hours. Frustration mounted among passengers due to persistent schedule changes and a lack of clear communication from the airline. This situation prompted worries about missed work obligations and travel plans, while many sought refunds, specifically criticizing the airline for not providing accommodations during the lengthy wait.

title: UP man rapes GF, kills her after taking sexual stimulant drug at hotel on birthday
content: A 23-year-old man allegedly booked a hotel room and consumed a sexual stimulant drug. He then raped his 22-year-old girlfriend and murdered her when she resisted. The woman, a Dalit, was returning to her village for Raksha Bandhan. Police recovered the victim's mobile phone and stimulant tablets from the accused. An FIR was registered under murder and rape sections of the BNS.

title: Imran Khan row: PCB warns Pak players against speaking about jailed former captain
content: The Pakistan Cricket Board has instructed its players to refrain from making public comments about Imran Khan's health amidst his ongoing imprisonment and health concerns that have drawn international interest. The board deems an interview with Khan's sons as politically motivated. Former cricketers Moin Khan and Javed Miandad have voiced their support for his medical needs, while international cricket captains have reached out to Pakistan's Prime Minister regarding his situation.

title: ‘Excessive speed’: 8-yr-old killed as woman driver on phone runs him over in Mumbai
content: An eight-year-old boy tragically died after being hit by a speeding car in Mumbai's Bandra area. The driver, a forty-five-year-old woman, was allegedly distracted by a mobile phone call. The incident occurred on John Baptist Road, near Jijamata Garden, on Sunday afternoon. The boy sustained severe injuries and was rushed to Holy Family Hospital. Police have arrested the woman and registered a case against her.

content: Some 237 people have been rescued, Northern Cyprus Prime Minister Unal Ustel told Turkish state-run TRT news channel. He said a search was underway for another 24 people.

content: The Arctic island of 4,00,000 people has debated whether to join the EU for well over a decade and had initially been expected to narrowly back holding membership talks, but opinion polls this month showed views had changed.

content: Maduro and his wife, Cilia Flores, were seized in Caracas during a US military operation in January. They are being detained in a Brooklyn, New York jail on drug trafficking and firearms possession charges, which they deny.

title: NHAI mandates end-to-end AI-MC deployment for projects over 20 km in length
content: NHAI has made Automated and Intelligent Machine-Aided Construction compulsory for highway projects longer than 20 km in length . the technology will be used for every major layer of highway, including embankment, subgrade and Granular Sub-Base (GSB)

title: Rebuilt with India aid, flood-erased Nepal school seeks help to rebuild on higher ground
content: teachers and students agree on one thing: classes must restart at the earliest, but the school must never be rebuilt beside the river . 900 students at tribhuvan Trishuli Secondary School escaped before the river wipes out the 76-year-old campus . the school has to rise on higher ground .

title: H-4 EAD: What latest US move means for Indian spouses of H-1Bs
content: the proposed rollback of H-4 EADs has sparked concern among thousands of Indian families in the US . no changes are in effect yet and any repeal could take months . the proposal would reverse the 2015 rule that made eligible H-4 spouses of H-1B workers eligible for employment authorization .

title: PM Modi likely to hold bilateral talks with Iranian president
